name: Mento Ghanaian Cedi
oneLiner: GHSm is Mento's Ghanaian cedi stablecoin on Celo, minted CDP-style against USDm collateral (Mento V3, a Liquity v2 fork).
collateral: Mento V3 Liquity-v2-style CDPs collateralized by USDm; USDm in turn is backed by the diversified Mento Reserve mix (sUSDS, CELO, EURC, USDC, USDT, axlEUROC, stETH, and smaller positions exposed via the Mento reserve dashboard).
pegMechanism: Mento V3 oracle-priced FX stablecoin minted by depositing USDm as CDP collateral and borrowing GHSm against it; user-set interest rates, Stability Pool liquidations, and Liquity-style redemptions support the GHSm peg, with circuit breakers and Mento reserve transparency on the upstream USDm leg.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: GHSm inherits upstream freeze exposure because the Mento reserve mix includes tracked freezable stablecoins such as USDC, USDT, and EURC.

notices.title: Peg grouped as Other
notices.message: GHS is not yet a first-class Pharos peg-currency enum, so GHSm is grouped under OTHER while the DefiLlama price and circulating-supply path admits the asset at runtime.

mintAuthority.summary: GHSm is minted CDP-style on Celo by depositing USDm as collateral in Mento V3 (a Liquity v2 fork); Mento DAO (veMENTO) governs via a timelock, with stablecoin contract ownership held by a 4/7 multisig during the V3 rollout.

controls.label: Mento V3 borrower/minter contracts
controls.capDescription: GHSm mints only against USDm CDP collateral in the Mento V3 Liquity-v2-fork system; supply tracks collateralized borrowing and redemptions rather than an issuer minter.
controls.evidence: Mento V3 docs describe FX stablecoins minted by depositing USDm as CDP collateral with Liquity-style redemptions and Stability Pool liquidations.

controls.label: Mento DAO governance / stablecoin contract owner
controls.capDescription: Mento DAO (veMENTO) governs via a timelock; per MGP-14 the owner role of Mento V3 stablecoin contracts was transferred to a 4/7 multisig to orchestrate the V3 rollout.
controls.evidence: Mento governance docs describe a veMENTO DAO with a governance timelock; MGP-14 transferred Mento V3 stablecoin contract ownership to a 4/7 multisig for the deployment rollout.

review.evidence: Mento V3 docs and the MGP-14 deployment proposal describe collateralized CDP minting of FX stables against USDm, governed by the Mento DAO timelock with a 4/7 multisig owning the stablecoin contracts during rollout.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Mint mechanism and governance model confirmed from Mento docs and MGP-14; the live GHSm Celo token owner address was not independently read.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the live GHSm Celo token owner (Mento Timelock vs 4/7 multisig) and borrower-operations/circuit-breaker admins before raising confidence.
